make great strides: Thanks to daily practice, Kevin has made great strides in his English speaking this semester.
多虧每天練習，凱文這學期的英語口說大有進步。
take in one's stride: Moving to a new school was hard, but Lily took it in her stride and made friends quickly.
轉到新學校很辛苦，但莉莉從容應對，很快就交到朋友。
stride into the room: The confident new manager likes to stride into the room and greet everyone with a big smile.
那位自信的新經理喜歡大步走進房間，用燦爛的笑容向大家打招呼。
hit one's stride: The runner started slowly, but after the first lap she hit her stride and passed everyone.
那名跑者起跑很慢，但第一圈過後她進入狀況，超越了所有人。
strike a balance: It is not easy for high school students to strike a balance between schoolwork and sleep.
對高中生來說，要在課業和睡眠之間取得平衡並不容易。
strike a deal: After hours of talks, the two companies finally managed to strike a deal on the new project.
經過數小時的談判，兩家公司終於就新計畫達成協議。
strike gold: The small shop seemed to strike gold when its bubble tea became popular on social media.
那家小店的珍珠奶茶在社群媒體上爆紅，似乎大獲成功。
strike a chord: The movie about a lonely grandfather seemed to strike a chord with many young viewers.
那部關於孤單爺爺的電影似乎引起了許多年輕觀眾的共鳴。
strike a pose: When the photographer raised the camera, the models would strike a pose and smile.
攝影師一舉起相機，模特兒們就會擺姿勢並微笑。
workers strike: When workers strike for higher pay, trains and buses may stop running for several days.
當工人為了加薪罷工時，火車和公車可能會停駛好幾天。
strike out: If you strike out again, the coach may take you out of the game, so watch the ball carefully.
如果你再被三振出局，教練可能會把你換下場，所以要仔細看球。
strike a match: When the lights went out, my father had to strike a match to find the flashlight.
停電時，我爸爸得劃火柴才能找到手電筒。
it strikes me that: Every time I visit Grandma, it strikes me that she seems happier living in the quiet countryside.
每次我去看奶奶，我都會突然想到她住在安靜的鄉下似乎比較快樂。
strip someone of a title: After the athlete was caught using drugs, the officials decided to strip him of his title.
那名運動員被抓到使用禁藥後，官方決定剝奪他的頭銜。
strip away the layers: The documentary tries to strip away the layers of lies and show what really happened.
這部紀錄片試圖把謊言層層剝去，呈現真正發生的事。
strip the paint: Before painting the old door blue, we had to strip the paint that was already peeling off.
在把舊門漆成藍色前，我們得先除去已經剝落的漆。
strip down to basics: To save money, the company decided to strip down to basics and stop all extra services.
為了省錢，公司決定回歸基本，停止所有額外服務。
strip-search: At the border, the police may strip-search a traveler if they think he is hiding drugs.
在邊境，如果警方認為旅客藏有毒品，可能會對他脫衣搜身。
strip the bed: Before the guests arrive, please strip the bed and put clean sheets on it.
客人到之前，請把床單拆下來，換上乾淨的床單。
strive for excellence: Our school motto encourages every student to strive for excellence in both study and sports.
我們的校訓鼓勵每位學生在課業和運動上都追求卓越。
strive to improve: Even after winning the contest, the young pianist continues to strive to improve every day.
即使贏了比賽，那位年輕鋼琴家仍每天持續努力進步。
strive against the odds: The poor boy had to strive against the odds, working at night while studying for college.
那個貧窮男孩必須逆境奮鬥，一邊晚上打工一邊準備考大學。
strive for success: Parents should teach children to strive for success through hard work, not by cheating.
父母應該教孩子透過努力力求成功，而不是靠作弊。
stroke one's ego: He only asked for our opinion to stroke his ego, because he never really listened to us.
他問我們的意見只是為了滿足虛榮心，因為他從沒真正聽我們說。
stroke the cat: My little sister loves to stroke the cat gently while it sleeps on the sofa.
我妹妹喜歡在貓睡在沙發上時輕輕撫摸牠。
a stroke of luck: By a stroke of luck, I found my lost wallet on the bus with all my money still inside.
好運的是，我在公車上找到遺失的錢包，裡面的錢都還在。
a stroke of genius: Using old bottles to build the house was a stroke of genius that saved a lot of money.
用舊瓶子蓋房子是天才之舉，省下了很多錢。
at a stroke: The new law will remove hundreds of unfair rules at a stroke, making life easier for farmers.
新法律將一舉廢除數百條不公平的規定，讓農民生活更輕鬆。
stroke someone's hair: The mother would stroke her daughter's hair softly to help her fall asleep.
那位媽媽會輕輕撫摸女兒的頭髮，幫助她入睡。
